alkylation reagent: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine was specified as fixed modification
cleavage agent: Trypsin was specified as enzyme, cleaving after all lysine and arginine residues and allowing up to two missed cleavages.
enrichment method: SILAC and TMT labelling, phospho-enrichment and mass spectrometry were carried out as described.
labeling: we performed TMT (Tandem Mass Tag) peptide-labelling and phospho-proteomic screening in U2OS cells
